INGLEWOOD  CALIFORNIA

  Library Board
  MINUTES – October 28, 2020

The Inglewood Library Board met on October 28, 2020 via Zoom. The meeting was called to order at 6:41 p.m. by
Board Member Pat Douglas.

Roll Call

Present:
  Pat Douglas – District 2 Board Member
  Ernesto Castillo – District 3 Board Member
  Jacqueline Cochran – District 4 Board Member

Absent Board Members:
  Patt Sanders – At Large Board Member, Chairman
  Julie Minton – District 1 Board Member, Vice Chairman

Staff:
  Harjinder Singh – Deputy to the City Manager
  Linda Silba – Principal Librarian of Adult Services
  Kerri Arroyo – Principal Librarian of Crenshaw-Imperial Library and Children’s Division at the Main Library
  Irina Martirosian – Staff Assistant

Approval of the Minutes

  Board Member Douglas made a motion for the approval of the minutes for September 23, 2020; Board
Member Castillo seconded the motion. Minutes were approved as follows:

  Ayes: Library Board Members Cochran, Castillo and Douglas
  Nays: None

  Deputy to the City Manager, Harjinder Singh made a recommendation to become a fine free library and
gave board members details about the research that was done. Mr. Singh asked for a vote that would give a
recommendation from the board.

  Board Member Cochran made a motion for Board Members to recommend the City Council to eliminate
fines and fees for library items. Board Member Castillo seconded the motion. Motion was approved as follows:

  Ayes: Library Board Members Cochran, Castillo and Douglas
  Nays: None

Public Comments

  None
  1
 Friends Report

  Susan Carleo, President of the Friends of Inglewood Public Library (FOIPL) informed the board that the
FOIPL are located on the first floor, in the outer lobby of the Main Library. After the library reopening there will be a
deposit box where people can drop their funds for the purchase of books/materials. Also, the books that people
don’t buy, the Friends will send to the Better World Book organization who sell books and give a percentage to the
FOIPL. The Friends also donate books to countries that don’t have access to printed materials. Ms. Carleo also
included FOIPL goals for 2021 and asked Board Members for ideas, thoughts and questions.

Library Report

  Deputy to the City Manager, Harjinder Singh talked about the library reopening plan that was discussed
with the Emergency Services Department, regarding the Depository and Teen Center, both spaces were cleaned
out and made available for the School District to use for children ages five to thirteen with special needs and for
English learners that are falling behind. Mr. Singh also discussed the changes made to the Library’s Organization
Chart to better operate and the assist public.
  Kerri Arroyo, Principal Librarian of the Crenshaw-Imperial Library and the Children’s Division at the Main
Library gave a presentation on the growth of the services and operations of the Library.
  Document: KA
  Principal Librarian of Adult, Teen and Hispanic Services, Linda Silba gave a presentation regarding some
of the enhancements that reflect the needs of the Inglewood community as well as the Library Social Media Plan
and Outreach Program.
  Document: LS
Public Comments

  None

Commissioner Comments

  All Board members thanked Mr. Singh, Kerri and Linda and were very happy with the staff reports.

  Deputy to the City Manager Harjinder Singh thanked everyone.

  With no further comments the meeting was adjourned at 8:26 p.m.
